Container.Name: TradeNot.es
Container.Overview: Free, open-source trading journal for futures, stock and prop-firm traders. Trades are imported from NinjaTrader (add-on), Interactive Brokers (Flex query), TradingView exports or CSV. Daily limits and rule-adherence analytics, reports, equity curve, R-multiples, an economic calendar, a daily journal and screenshots per trade, in six languages. Everything runs in this one container, including its own PostgreSQL database; all data is kept in /data. After the first start, open the WebUI and create your account: the first account becomes the administrator, then sign-up closes. No mail server needed.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, screenshots and daily database dumps (backups)

Config.Name: BASE_URL
Config.Description: The address you open TradeNot.es under, e.g. http://[server IP]:3000 or https://journal.example.com

Config.Name: TRUSTED_ORIGINS
Config.Description: Further addresses you open it under, comma-separated (e.g. the IP next to a domain)

Config.Name: ALLOW_SIGNUP
Config.Description: true: more people can create accounts after the first (admin) account

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: true when a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik, Caddy) is in front

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID owning the data folder

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID owning the data folder

Config.Name: SMTP_HOST
Config.Description: Optional mail server for password-reset mails (without one the reset link is written to the container log)

Config.Name: SMTP_USER
Config.Description: Mail server login (usually the sender address)

Config.Name: BACKUP_KEEP_DAYS
Config.Description: Days to keep the daily database dumps in /data/backups (0 = off)

Config.Name: MARKET_EVENTS
Config.Description: off: do not fetch Fed speeches and the White House schedule for the calendar
